plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp strength and power build for boxing with only one S&C session per week so it does not clash with sparring and skill work. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lift before percentage work begins in Weeks 2-4. The block keeps power first, then main strength, then a small amount of pulling, trunk, and neck work to build useful qualities without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body power and foundational squat strength while keeping accessory work brief and recoverable around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with small load increases while keeping weekly fatigue low enough for steady sport practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster, sharper output with lower fatigue while holding onto the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps. Jump as high and fast as you can and land softly in control.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and stick the landing cleanly.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Start from a still position and keep each rep crisp.

exercises.name: 2. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: This session sets your baseline for future percentage work. Warm up with small jumps in load, then perform one hard but technically solid top set of 3-5 reps.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max for the next block.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat

substitutionOptions.name: Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat
